verses.en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.pt: Eu sou a videira verdadeira, e meu Pai é o viticultor.
verses.en_web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
verses.en_bbe: I am the true vine and my Father is the gardener.

verses.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.pt: Toda vara em mim que não dá fruto, ele a corta; e toda vara que dá fruto, ele a limpa, para que dê mais fruto.
verses.en_web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.en_bbe: He takes away every branch in me which has no fruit, and every branch which has fruit he makes clean, so that it may have more fruit.

verses.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.pt: Vós já estais limpos pela palavra que vos tenho falado.
verses.en_web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.en_bbe: You are clean, even now, through the teaching which I have given you.

verses.en: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.pt: Permanecei em mim, e eu permanecerei em vós; como a vara de si mesma não pode dar fruto, se não permanecer na videira, assim também vós, se não permanecerdes em mim.
verses.en_web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
verses.en_bbe: Be in me at all times as I am in you. As the branch is not able to give fruit of itself, if it is not still on the vine, so you are not able to do so if you are not in me.

verses.en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.pt: Eu sou a videira; vós sois as varas. Quem permanece em mim e eu nele, esse dá muito fruto; porque sem mim nada podeis fazer.
verses.en_web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.en_bbe: I am the vine, you are the branches: he who is in me at all times as I am in him, gives much fruit, because without me you are able to do nothing.

verses.en: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.pt: Quem não permanece em mim é lançado fora, como a vara, e seca; tais varas são recolhidas, lançadas no fogo e queimadas.
verses.en_web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.en_bbe: If a man does not keep himself in me, he becomes dead and is cut off like a dry branch; such branches are taken up and put in the fire and burned.

verses.en: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.pt: Se vós permanecerdes em mim, e as minhas palavras permanecerem em vós, pedi o que quiserdes, e vos será feito.
verses.en_web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
verses.en_bbe: If you are in me at all times, and my words are in you, then anything for which you make a request will be done for you.

verses.en: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.pt: Nisto é glorificado meu Pai, que deis muito fruto; e assim sereis meus discípulos.
verses.en_web: “In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
verses.en_bbe: Here is my Father's glory, in that you give much fruit and so are my true disciples.

verses.en: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.pt: Como o Pai me amou, assim também eu vos amei; permanecei no meu amor.
verses.en_web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
verses.en_bbe: Even as the Father has given me his love, so I have given my love to you: be ever in my love.

verses.en: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.pt: Se guardardes os meus mandamentos, permanecereis no meu amor; do mesmo modo que eu tenho guardado os mandamentos de meu Pai, e permaneço no seu amor.
verses.en_web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
verses.en_bbe: If you keep my laws, you will be ever in my love, even as I have kept my Father's laws, and am ever in his love.

verses.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
verses.pt: Estas coisas vos tenho dito, para que o meu gozo permaneça em vós, e o vosso gozo seja completo.
verses.en_web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
verses.en_bbe: I have said these things to you so that I may have joy in you and so that your joy may be complete.

verses.en: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.pt: O meu mandamento é este: Que vos ameis uns aos outros, assim como eu vos amei.
verses.en_web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
verses.en_bbe: This is the law I give you: Have love one for another, even as I have love for you.

verses.en: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.pt: Ninguém tem maior amor do que este, de dar alguém a sua vida pelos seus amigos.
verses.en_web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
verses.en_bbe: Greater love has no man than this, that a man gives up his life for his friends.

verses.en: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.pt: Vós sois meus amigos, se fizerdes o que eu vos mando.
verses.en_web: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
verses.en_bbe: You are my friends, if you do what I give you orders to do.

verses.en: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.pt: Já não vos chamo servos, porque o servo não sabe o que faz o seu senhor; mas chamei-vos amigos, porque tudo quanto ouvi de meu Pai vos dei a conhecer.
verses.en_web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
verses.en_bbe: No longer do I give you the name of servants; because a servant is without knowledge of what his master is doing: I give you the name of friends, because I have given you knowledge of all the things which my Father has said to me.

verses.en: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.pt: Vós não me escolhestes a mim mas eu vos escolhi a vós, e vos designei, para que vades e deis frutos, e o vosso fruto permaneça, a fim de que tudo quanto pedirdes ao Pai em meu nome, ele vo-lo conceda.
verses.en_web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
verses.en_bbe: You did not take me for yourselves, but I took you for myself; and I gave you the work of going about and producing fruit which will be for ever; so that whatever request you make to the Father in my name he may give it to you.

verses.en: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.pt: Isto vos mando: que vos ameis uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
verses.en_bbe: So this is my law for you: Have love one for another.

verses.en: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
verses.pt: Se o mundo vos odeia, sabei que, primeiro do que a vós, me odiou a mim.
verses.en_web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.en_bbe: If you are hated by the world, keep in mind that I was hated by the world before you.

verses.en: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.pt: Se fôsseis do mundo, o mundo amaria o que era seu; mas, porque não sois do mundo, antes eu vos escolhi do mundo, por isso é que o mundo vos odeia.
verses.en_web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.en_bbe: If you were of the world, you would be loved by the world: but because you are not of the world, but I have taken you out of the world, you are hated by the world.

verses.en: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos da palavra que eu vos disse: Não é o servo maior do que o seu senhor. Se a mim me perseguiram, também vos perseguirão a vós; se guardaram a minha palavra, guardarão também a vossa.
verses.en_web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind the words I said to you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they were cruel to me, they will be cruel to you; if they kept my words, they will keep yours.

verses.en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.pt: Mas tudo isto vos farão por causa do meu nome, porque não conhecem aquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: They will do all this to you because of my name--because they have no knowledge of him who sent me.

verses.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
verses.pt: Se eu não viera e não lhes falara, não teriam pecado; agora, porém, não têm desculpa do seu pecado.
verses.en_web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.en_bbe: If I had not come and been their teacher they would have had no sin: but now they have no reason to give for their sin.

verses.en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.pt: Aquele que me odeia a mim, odeia também a meu Pai.
verses.en_web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
verses.en_bbe: He who has hate for me has hate for my Father.

verses.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.pt: Se eu entre eles não tivesse feito tais obras, quais nenhum outro fez, não teriam pecado; mas agora, não somente viram, mas também odiaram tanto a mim como a meu Pai.
verses.en_web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.
verses.en_bbe: If I had not done among them the works which no other man ever did, they would have had no sin: but now they have seen, and they have had hate in their hearts for me and my Father.

verses.en: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.pt: Mas isto é para que se cumpra a palavra que está escrita na sua lei: Odiaram-me sem causa.
verses.en_web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
verses.en_bbe: This comes about so that the writing in their law may be made true, Their hate for me was without cause.

verses.en: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.pt: Quando vier o Ajudador, que eu vos enviarei da parte do Pai, o Espírito da verdade, que do Pai procede, esse dará testemunho de mim;
verses.en_web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
verses.en_bbe: When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father even the Spirit of true knowledge who comes from the Father--he will give witness about me;

verses.en: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.pt: e também vós dareis testemunho, porque estais comigo desde o princípio.
verses.en_web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.en_bbe: And you, in addition, will give witness because you have been with me from the first.
